units.rationale: OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2669-2682 matches the document fields and lanes, and _harness_ensure_session_1 at line 3843 issues controller ensure-session with TEST_RUNNER_ENCHRON_CONTROLS_AUTO_HIDE_SECONDS when controlsAutoHideSeconds present, returning session and controlsAutoHideSeconds. The optional integer field has minimum 1 maximum 300, so argument sufficiency is closed and no helper indexes a missing field. Invalidates lane.instance is accurate for a runner restart.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2822 declares only optional rootFolderName and no evidence, and _harness_reset_product_state_2 at line 3910 maps to controller resetState which deletes enchron.* UserDefaults keys and presentation state. The 20 invalidatesTags (app.session, certificate.trust, library.contents, presentation.mode/state, source.connection etc.) honestly describe the disturbed stores, unlike ensure-session which only lists lane.instance for the same cold launch effect but is defensible because ensure-session is lane-scoped.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2824-2854 declares check required with choices including remote-faults, smb-aggregate, audio-fixtures etc., and _host_preflight at line 796 enforces the phase/recipe/receiptID cross-validation: ensure forbids both, activate requires closed recipe from _remote_preflight.remote.RECIPE_NAMES, restore requires receiptID matching receipt:g-[0-9]{6} pattern. The schema marks phase/recipe/receiptID optional but the cross-validator closes the gaps, so no unconditional index of a missing optional occurs.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:3201-3237 declares targetDomain required with when-equals rule requiring shotX/Y/Width/Height for canvas and systemControl for system-toolbar, and _device_hub at line 2443 validates targetDomain home-only and point-inside-screenshot. The invalidatesTags presentation.state and ui.state are minimal but honest for a pinch that delivers spatial input; library.contents is not listed yet the operation does not claim to import, so the tag correctly reflects only the input state it disturbs.

Zero-argument OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:3200 maps to _input_device_hub_prepare_1 at line 8213 which launches Device Hub and widens the window to fit, returning a binding that later pinches require. Simulator-only lane matches references/simulator.md spatial input delegation, and invalidatesTags lane.instance and input.device-hub correctly describe the disturbed hub window and session binding.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2950-2968 declares closed category choices via ISSUE_INDUCE_RECIPES (source-file-missing, source-access-denied, connection-interrupted, media-data-corrupt, server-certificate-changed) and _issue_present_1 at line 5671 maps each to remote-fault recipes, opens WebDAV fixture if not already in window playback, activates via host.preflight remote-faults and waits on PlayerUI-window-control-plane error plus slot identifiers. InvalidatesTags honestly list certificate.trust, fixture.corpus, issue.surface, playback and source state disturbed by the remote fault actuation.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2970-2993 declares all six baseline fields as optional string-list with all-or-none rule, plus priorSnapshot and systemImportExpectation, and _library_snapshot at line 2485 validates baseline completeness and uniqueness and priorSnapshot result reference pattern result://call:/snapshot. EvidenceType library.command with schema library-command@1 is obtainable via librarySnapshot transient observation, and invalidatesTags empty is correct for a read-only snapshot that does not disturb state.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2913 declares required fileName validated by _direct_filename at line 2247 which rejects absolute paths and slash-containing names, and the handler at line 6176 copies from TestMediaInbox and invokes importMedia, returning library.command evidence. Invalidates library.contents honestly reflects the mutated library reference set; lane supports both device and simulator.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2925-2949 declares identifier required with prefix allowlist MediaLibrary-grid-video-/FileBrowsing-grid-video-/Emby-Episode- validated by _media_open at line 2285, expectedLanding with choices window/portal/either-main-window, deadlineSeconds 1-90, and optional relatedResults. EvidenceType window.control-plane is obtainable via _media_open_2 at line 6354 which waits on PlayerUI-window-control-plane diagnostic string, and invalidatesTags correctly list playback and presentation state disturbed by opening media.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2912 declares required fixtureID and sourceRoot, with _stage_fixture at line 2227 enforcing sourceRoot absolute path, and handler at line 6176 copies the fixture file to the inbox under a sanitized basename. Invalidates fixture.corpus honestly describes the staged corpus mutation; no evidence is declared which matches execution-protocol that setup artifacts satisfy no coverage obligation.

OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2723 declares required tab with closed choices files/settings/emby/environment, and handler at line 4303 taps the tab identifier for real via the controller. Product-behavior role is correct because it uses public navigation ornament hit testing, and invalidatesTags ui.navigation and ui.state honestly describe the disturbed navigation state.

Spec at regression_operation_adapter.py:3072 declares required presentation (window/portal/either-main-window), lifecycle (playing/ready/paused/ended/any-steady) and controls (shown/hidden/either) with deadline 1-90, but its document role is evidence and it implements only a read loop via _wait_for_window at line 3485 polling PlayerUI-window-control-plane, so the role matches the evidence-only behavior. Evidence window.control-plane is obtainable in window/portal per product.md:17, and empty invalidatesTags is correct for a wait.
